finalRpiThrough._comment: season -> YYYY-MM-DD of the D1 College Cup final (issue #249). Once a weekly RPI snapshot of the season being played is dated on or after it, that season is finished site-wide (D1, D2, D3). Enter it once a year, only from an NCAA page that names the date, and cite that page here. Must fall between Nov 15 of the season and Jan 31 of the next, or the build refuses it. 2026 is not entered yet: issue #290.
